story: A group of 30 riders were only able to get clear with 70 km to go after a fast start. The break splintered to 10 on the hills and Alec Segaert attacked with the final climb in sight. Pablo Castrillo caught Segaert and on his turn was joined by Vine. In the end Vine dropped Castrillo on the climb and soloed to victory in the polka dot jersey. In the GC Vingegaard took the red jersey from Træen.
